$comment: THE SINGLE SOURCE OF THE ZIPPIE VISUAL LANGUAGE.
Three surfaces render this system: the hub at zippie.ts.example-home.invalid, the iOS
companion, and the Android companion. They were three different products -
the hub a developer console, iOS a designed dashboard, Android whatever
Compose defaults to - and 'keep them consistent' by discipline has never
So the tokens live here and the platform files are GENERATED. A colour that
differs between iOS and the hub is now impossible to introduce by hand; it
would have to be introduced here, once, deliberately, for all three.
Values are recorded from the built iOS app (DESIGN.md, 2026-08-05), which is
the surface that had a designed system. The hub and Android adopt it rather
than negotiating a compromise none of them wanted.

secondary.use: supporting text, tinted from the ground and never neutral gray

tertiary.use: the quietest text; a reserve leg is not news

rule.use: hairlines, the structural device in place of cards

live.use: CARRYING TRAFFIC RIGHT NOW - the only accent, and it means exactly one thing

degraded.use: holding on, not failing - amber because crying wolf in a car is worse than saying nothing

space.$comment: One rhythm. More space above a heading than below it.

display.use: the state sentence, and the only thing at this size

section.use: not tracked-out micro caps, which is the eyebrow habit in a different hat

figure.use: every changing number, so values do not jitter as they update

state.$comment: The VOCABULARY is part of the design system, not per-platform copy. Three surfaces describing the same leg in three different words is the same failure as three different blues.

rules.$comment: Design rules that outrank aesthetics on every surface. Generated into each platform as comments so they travel with the code.
rules.neverStateUnmeasured: An unmeasured value is ABSENT, not a placeholder dash or a zero.
rules.weightIsNotMembership: A leg with weight that the transport does not hold is NOT carrying.
rules.reserveIsNotBroken: A leg held back by the tier gate is doing its job and must not be drawn as a failure.
rules.emptyTrackWhenNothingCarried: A leg that has carried nothing draws an empty track, never a full bar.
rules.sourceFollowsHeading: A heading claims only what the surface can currently see.
